We are writing to let you know that external redecoration and gutter replacement will begin at your building on 24 May 2026. Scaffolding will be erected the week before.
You do not need to do anything for the works to go ahead. Our contractor, Mills Maintenance, will knock before working near your windows.

obligations.ask: Tell us if you have a medical condition affecting noise or dust

results.segment: If you have a medical condition that means noise or dust would affect you, please tell us within 21 days so we can plan around it.
Work is expected to take 6 weeks, weather permitting.
